verdict: Organic engagement declining across all locations; paid channels are inactive.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, every lead and business profile action came from organic sources alone — no paid spend ran on Meta or Google Ads for the full 28 days. Combined, your Google Business Profile listings generated 408 total actions (calls, direction requests, and web clicks), but engagement fell sharply in the final week: O'Hare Precision dropped 57%, Forte Metals 48%, and Advance Grinding 19% week over week. The pattern is consistent across locations, pointing to a broader softening in local search demand or visibility rather than an isolated issue at any one site. We are reviewing each listing's local search presence now and will have an assessment of next steps ready for the coming week.
